urls.description: It is not clear who could replace Huang if he is forced to step down.
urls.title: Nvidia board weighs Jensen Huang’s future after affair with alleged spy

data.text: Breaking news: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia amid reports of two affairs, one of which included a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, marking a stunning downfall for one of the world’s most powerful executives. https://t.co/atBPSfG3vk
